## What was implemented and observed

The harness verifies supplied implementation/harness pins and the frozen first-slice support
pin before loading those reviewed local modules. The old source-acquisition checks are used
unchanged to validate fresh exact manifest/source fixtures; no scientific module is loaded.
The protected object is a real sealed Linux memfd, and the derivative is a real positioned
read into immutable bytes. The fixed six-positional-argument receiver checks inert data and
returns a tuple; it does not compile/evaluate/execute/import source, open source paths, call
clients, create processes or use a network.

Store reservations and registration precede preparation. File and directory synchronization
precede dispatch; ATTEMPTED is linked into the witness only after its write/sync returns.
The profiling sentinel observes actual fixed-code-object entry/return events. Independent
witness state reads actual frame arguments, computes their length/hash, compares retained B
identity, independently reads A, and records parameter and dispatch association. Consumer
return values cannot populate that witness. Finalization validates the serialized witness;
terminal records hash it. Dispatch hash mismatches refuse, including a genuine observed
entry followed by a deliberately corrupted evidence link.

No-reopen requests are denied by the explicit guard without performing the requested read.
The test creates a genuinely altered decoy source file after acquisition; it is never consumed.
The fixed receiver and attempt paths contain no payload-path fallback. This is reviewed
fixed-program/adapter coverage, not a hostile-process syscall interception claim.

Recovery uses retained files only, preserving raw partial/invalid evidence. It produces
ABORTED for incomplete attempts, never retries consumption, and binds the raw journal and
valid prefix to its attempt ID. Tests reopen the store and verify every already terminal
record byte remains unchanged. An interrupted recovery write leaves an actual 37-byte partial
file, which is preserved when recovery is completed idempotently after reopening.

## Acceptance results and limits

Final direct harness exit: **0**. Final observed inventory: **37 cases**:

| Evidence category | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Positive | PASS: two fresh P01 attempts ACCEPTED, with distinct attempt IDs and actual entry witnesses. |
| Refusal | PASS: 27 normal REFUSED outcomes across N01–N20 families and bounded subcases. |
| Recovery | PASS: eight ABORTED outcomes, including reservation/registration/PREPARED/ATTEMPTED/torn-write interruptions, wrong-ID/cross-attempt witness and interrupted recovery-write restart. |
| Witness | PASS: real incoming argument measurement, independent A read/reference association and return linkage; missing entry or wrong dispatch evidence refuses. |
| Substitution defense | PASS: initial/post-binding A, changed/equal-byte B, wrong/rebound surrogate, altered-decoy reopen/fallback, invocation and source-environment/channel/cwd cases refuse. |
| Precedence | PASS: combined denied reopen and object substitution emits PATHNAME_REOPEN primary and OBJECT_SUBSTITUTION diagnostic. |
| Determinism | PASS: 174 complete retained records round-trip to byte-identical canonical bytes; repeated positive witnesses agree after removing only attempt ID and its derived dispatch link. Unique-ID terminal bytes correctly differ. |

The code names are checked against observed outcomes, not emitted as prebuilt expected
observations. Fault adapters are explicit: shortened derivative read; pre-binding candidate
corruption; separate equal-byte objects; controlled receiver rebinding; missing or corrupted
witness records; and controlled interruption points. They do not claim spontaneous kernel
faults or unobserved attacks. Recovery interruptions are controlled stops/write faults and
store reopening in the acceptance harness, not a killed operating system or power-loss test.
Both stores and raw corrupted/partial records are preserved in the embedded archive.

The initial development acceptance run also passed (2 positive, 25 refusal, 7 recovery).
It emitted a harmless Python invalid-escape SyntaxWarning in a regex; that spelling was
corrected. Before final acceptance, dispatch-reference checks, post-qualification receiver
checks and recovery-write/reopen coverage were strengthened. The initial source/harness
bytes and complete records remain archived separately, with their own pins. No failed
acceptance run is omitted; no initial result is attributed to the final source pins.
